content: अव्ययीभावः [अनव्ययमव्ययं भवत्यनेन; अव्यय-च्वि-भू करणे घञ्] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the four principal kinds of compounds in Sanskrit, an adverbial or indeclinable compound (formed of an indeclinable, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a preposition or an adverb, and a noun); अधिहरि, सतृणम् <ab>&c.</ab> पूर्वपदप्रधानोऽव्ययीभावः . .²2 Absence of expenditure (owing to poverty); द्वन्द्वो द्विगुरपि चाहं मद्गेहे नित्यमव्ययीभावः . तत्पुरुष कर्मधारय येनाहं स्यां बहुव्रीहिः .. <ls>Udb.</ls> (which, by the bye, gives the names of compounds in Sanskrit). .²3 Unchangeable state, imperishableness.
